analyst.summary: Emami is a financially strong, debt-free FMCG company with well-known personal-care brands and high returns on capital, but revenue growth has stalled to near-zero over the past year amid rising competition, and reported profit growth has been helped by an unusually low and volatile effective tax rate rather than purely operating improvement. We rate this a Sell: balance-sheet quality is real, but the growth engine has genuinely stopped and there is no clear catalyst visible to restart it.
